breakdown.description: A neutral-state Freysoldt correction is requested while the workflow is directed to use charged-defect outputs.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly requested a neutral-state correction while directing the workflow to use charged defect outputs. The generated specification resolves this by using charge state 0 (neutral) and loading generic LOCPOT files without any reference to charged defect outputs, aligning with the ground truth's intent of loading all available Mg_Ga subfolder data without the contradictory charged-defect constraint.
